import re
import sys

values = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

for name, source in re.findall(r'\b(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|TMP|\d+)\b', text):
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
